correctness.rationale: Exact conditional squared-spin recursion and total-magnetization recursion; strict concavity of a log-product proves q_m sign for all m>=3 and all interior parameters; conditioning on parent choices yields the all-generation formula, with n=2,3 boundaries. The stable negative-parameter recursion and convergent positive-parameter series establish infinite limits; Catalan and harmonic sums give 2-pi^2/6 at theta=1/2. Independent exact rational enumeration of recursive tree attachment sequences through n=8 passed 399 assertions. Test scope does not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The conditional second moment of the elephant walk is a central model statistic, while its memory genealogy is not revealed by marginal diffusion formulas. All nontrivial root attachments after vertex three have strictly positive covariance with this quadratic observable even when anti-copying dominates. The finite-time sign theorem, asymptotic sign-preserving regimes and exact threshold constant 2-pi^2/6 give a distinct motivated mixed-observable law with relevance to degree-conditioned memory dynamics.
